label: Airwallex sandbox · test money
simulated: The approver is a labelled virtual test passkey ("governance-live virtual test passkey (no person's Face ID)", src/redteam/authenticator.ts), enrolled as the only passkey of the run's own fresh ledger. Its signatures go through the same verification as a phone's (WebAuthn assertion over the exact terms hash); no person's Face ID was used.

The CFO's phone is played by the run: the hours are set with the phone's own path (a signed policy change, processPolicyRequest; setting hours is a tightening, which the phone may sign). The runner's steps after an approval (executePolicyChange, then syncCardsAfterPolicy) are called by the run once, in order, not by a running `npm run relay` and its every-few-seconds loop.

Purser's clock is injected for the end of the hours (as test/card-governance.test.ts does): Purser judged the window and the hours at 19:59:30 and 20:00:30 Amsterdam, while the thaw, the authorisation, the freeze and the read-backs reached Airwallex at 11:27 UTC. Nothing waited for real hours.
Every merchant charge is the sandbox's simulation endpoint (`POST /simulation/issuing/create`); the approve or decline is Airwallex's own.

passes.note: A fresh ledger of its own (no card drill card adopted: a new card was issued, nickname suffix `governance-1126`). The hours are `Mon-Fri 18:00-20:00 Europe/Amsterdam`; the run ran at 12:27 in Amsterdam, outside them. For `hours.thaw_inside` Purser's clock was set to 26 Nov 19:59:30 Amsterdam (18:59:30 UTC) and for `hours.end_sync` and `hours.no_window_after` to 20:00:30 (19:00:30 UTC); every Airwallex call happened at the run's real time (the table's times). Before the runs, 14 read-only calls checked the sandbox (10 in three probes: the platform's and the connected account's balances, GET /account, which answered `acct_op0_QItiOyWKsYb5pwQihA`, and the connected account's beneficiaries; 4 in the entities run's two stopped attempts, described in docs/runs/2026-11-26-entities-live.md). None moved money or changed anything; they are not in this record's call table. The runs (11:27 to 11:32 UTC) ran on the code committed right after them as `86d7f6b93`; between the runs and that commit only the records' wording, the stand-in's call counter and two unused imports changed.

Real time passing: the end of the hours is Purser's injected clock, not a wait until 20:00; the runner's every-few-seconds loop did not run (the sync was called once).

The authorisation approved inside the window was not written to this run's ledger: the window was opened under the injected clock and Airwallex dates the authorisation at the real time, so the ledger's window match would not have applied. Its answer is in the step's facts and the call table.
